body: Apache-2.0 adds an explicit patent grant and a clearer contribution clause and restricts nothing MIT permitted. Done in one commit for every place the license is named (LICENSE, README badge and footer, brand.json, llms.txt), because a half-applied relicense is worse than either state. Copies obtained as 0.1.0 remain MIT. Shipped in v0.1.1 on 2026-09-09 (commit dated 2026-09-09). Copyright line: 2026 khanakia.
title: Relicensed from MIT to Apache-2.0
